title: YAML metadata-as-code document
description: A single document (one `---`-separated section of a *.yml/*.yaml file) in the datahub-yaml-source format. Discriminated by `kind` for entity documents, or by `aspectName` for raw aspect passthrough documents. See docs/sources/yaml/yaml.md for the full reference.

AssertionAssertionDoc.description:
Union of the FRESHNESS / SQL / FIELD assertion shapes, kept flat.

Only the fields relevant to `type` will be populated by the author; the
assertion builder picks which ones to read based on `type`.

type.description: FRESHNESS, SQL, or FIELD -- selects which fields below apply.
type.title: Type

entityUrn.description: Full URN of the dataset this assertion checks.
entityUrn.title: Entityurn

cron.description: [FRESHNESS] cron expression, if scheduleType is CRON.
cron.title: Cron

timezone.description: [FRESHNESS] IANA timezone for the cron schedule.
timezone.title: Timezone

AssertionAssertionDoc.title: AssertionAssertionDoc

AssertionDoc.description: A data quality assertion (freshness, SQL-based, or field-level check).
AssertionDoc.title: AssertionDoc

ContainerDoc.description:
A container (database, schema, bucket, ...). Emitted with parents
before children automatically, regardless of declaration order across
files. See `ContainerRef` for how the URN is computed.

instance.description: Platform instance name. Does not affect the container's URN.
instance.title: Instance

env.description: Does not affect the container's URN.
env.title: Env

parentContainer.description: Reference to the parent container, if any (e.g. a schema's parent database).

ContainerDoc.title: ContainerDoc

ContainerRef.description:
Reference to a container by its natural (platform, database, schema) key.

Only `platform` + `database` + `schema` determine the container's URN;
`instance` and `env` are accepted but never affect it (they're only used
for the separate `dataPlatformInstance` aspect). See the "Container URN
computation" section in yaml.md.

instance.description: Platform instance name. Does not affect the container's URN.
instance.title: Instance

env.description: Does not affect the container's URN.
env.title: Env

ContainerRef.title: ContainerRef

actor.description: Owner name; converted to a corpuser URN if not already one.
actor.title: Actor

DataFlowDoc.description: A pipeline (e.g. an Airflow DAG, a dbt project run).

orchestrator.description: e.g. 'airflow', 'dbt'. Becomes part of the dataFlow URN.
orchestrator.title: Orchestrator

cluster.description: Deployment/cluster identifier, part of the dataFlow URN.
cluster.title: Cluster

DataFlowDoc.title: DataFlowDoc

DataFlowJobRef.description: Reference to a DATA_JOB by its natural (orchestrator, flowId, cluster, jobId) key.
DataFlowJobRef.title: DataFlowJobRef

DataFlowRef.description: Reference to a DATA_FLOW by its natural (orchestrator, flowId, cluster) key.
DataFlowRef.title: DataFlowRef

dataFlow.description: Reference to the parent DATA_FLOW this task belongs to.

fineGrainedLineages.description: Column-level lineage edges from inputDatasets to outputDatasets.
fineGrainedLineages.title: Finegrainedlineages

DataPlatformDoc.description:
Registers a custom data platform (e.g. one not built into DataHub's
core platform list). Not needed for well-known platforms like `postgres`
or `duckdb` -- only for platforms DataHub doesn't already know about.

type.description: One of DataHub's PlatformType enum values, e.g. RELATIONAL_DB, OTHERS.
type.title: Type

DataPlatformDoc.title: DataPlatformDoc

DataProcessInstanceDoc.description:
A single run of a DATA_JOB, with its own run-event history. For
ongoing/incremental run events after the initial run, prefer an
`aspectName: DATA_PROCESS_INSTANCE_RUN_EVENT` raw-aspect document instead
of appending to `runEvents` here.

parentTemplate.description: Reference to the DATA_JOB this is a run of.

DataProcessInstanceDoc.title: DataProcessInstanceDoc

DataProductDoc.description:
A data product: a curated bundle of datasets/jobs presented as a
single discoverable asset, with its own domain/tags/owners.

structuredProperties.description: Map of structuredProperty qualifiedName -> value (or list of values).
structuredProperties.title: Structuredproperties

assets.description: Full URNs of the entities (datasets, dataJobs, ...) that make up this product.
assets.title: Assets

DataProductDoc.title: DataProductDoc

DatasetRef.description: Reference to a dataset by its natural (platform, name, env) key.
DatasetRef.title: DatasetRef

DomainDoc.description:
A business domain, used to group related datasets/data products.
Referenced elsewhere via `domains: <id>`.
DomainDoc.title: DomainDoc

upstream.description: Source column. Absent for e.g. operation: CONSTANT, where the downstream value is a literal with no source column.

operation.description: Free-text transform description, e.g. IDENTITY, CONSTANT.
operation.title: Operation

ForeignKeyDoc.description: A foreign key constraint from this dataset's schema to another dataset.

foreignDataset.description: The dataset the foreign key points to.

ForeignKeyDoc.title: ForeignKeyDoc

GlossaryNodeDoc.description: A glossary category/folder that groups related glossary terms.

id.description: Stable identifier, becomes urn:li:glossaryNode:<id>. Referenced via 'parentNode'.
id.title: Id

parentNode.description: id of a parent GLOSSARY_NODE, for nested categories.
parentNode.title: Parentnode

GlossaryNodeDoc.title: GlossaryNodeDoc

GlossaryTermDoc.description: A glossary term. Referenced elsewhere via `glossaryTerms: [<id>]`.

parentNode.description: id of the GLOSSARY_NODE this term belongs to.
parentNode.title: Parentnode

GlossaryTermDoc.title: GlossaryTermDoc

RawAspectDoc.description:
Passthrough document for directly emitting an existing DataHub aspect.

Discriminated by the presence of `aspectName` rather than `kind`. All
fields other than `aspectName` and the entity reference are treated as
the raw payload for that aspect class. Different aspects attach to
different entity types, so the entity reference is one of several
mutually-exclusive fields depending on `aspectName`:
  - `dataset`: for dataset-scoped aspects (DATASET_PROFILE, OPERATION, ...)
  - `assertionUrn`: for ASSERTION_RUN_EVENT (already a full URN string)
  - `dataProcessInstanceUrn`: for DATA_PROCESS_INSTANCE_RUN_EVENT (full URN string)
RawAspectDoc.title: RawAspectDoc

SchemaBlock.description: A dataset's full schema: its fields and any foreign keys.
SchemaBlock.title: SchemaBlock

SchemaFieldDoc.description: A single column/field in a dataset's schema.

type.description: A DataHub schema type: number, string, boolean, date, time, bytes, record.
type.title: Type

nativeDataType.description: The source system's own type name, e.g. VARCHAR(255).
nativeDataType.title: Nativedatatype

SchemaFieldDoc.title: SchemaFieldDoc

StructuredPropertyDoc.description:
A custom structured property definition (a typed, filterable field
attachable to datasets/data products/etc, beyond built-in DataHub fields).

cardinality.description: SINGLE or MULTIPLE values allowed per entity.
cardinality.title: Cardinality

valueType.description: One of DataHub's data types: string, number, date, rich_text, urn, ...
valueType.title: Valuetype

allowedValues.description: Restrict to an enum of allowed values; omit to allow any value.
allowedValues.title: Allowedvalues

entityTypes.description: Which entity types this property can be attached to, e.g. [dataset, dataProduct].
entityTypes.title: Entitytypes

typeQualifier.description: For valueType 'urn': list of allowed target entity-type URNs (e.g. 'urn:li:entityType:datahub.dataProduct'). Maps to the 'allowedTypes' qualifier.
typeQualifier.title: Typequalifier

settings.description: Where this property is surfaced in the DataHub UI.

StructuredPropertyDoc.title: StructuredPropertyDoc

TagDoc.description: A tag definition. Referenced elsewhere via `tags: [<name>]`.
TagDoc.title: TagDoc

UpstreamLineageDoc.description: Table-level and (optionally) column-level lineage for a dataset.
UpstreamLineageDoc.title: UpstreamLineageDoc
